channel.title: Libya - The African Street Journal
channel.description: Daily news from Libya, every source cited.

item.title: Libya and Italy sign economic cooperation deal
item.description: Tripoli Chamber of Commerce and the Joint Italian-Arab Chamber of Commerce agreed to boost trade and investment.

item.title: Libyan PM discusses market instability with traders
item.description: Abdel Hamid Aldabaiba met with traders and chambers of commerce in Misrata to address commodity prices and import regulations.

item.title: UN extends Libya mission until October 2027
item.description: Security Council resolution backs efforts to unify state institutions and hold elections within two years.

item.title: Armed group closes Libya oil pipeline valve
item.description: National Oil Corporation reports 15,000 barrels per day of crude oil supply to Zawia refinery disrupted.

item.title: Libya limits insulin distribution to electronic system
item.description: New insulin shipments have arrived, but distribution will now only reach registered patients.
